# One World

> One World is an open-source 2D top-down life gamification engine built with Phaser. It turns real-life habits, tasks, and long-term goals into an explorable RPG world, playable directly in any modern web browser without installation.

## What it is

One World is a life gamification engine. It maps daily routines onto a 2D top-down game world: habits become skills, real-world goals become quests, and progress is tracked through character stats and XP rather than streaks.

## Core features

- Habit system: daily habits become in-game skills that level up with consistent practice.
- Quest engine: real-world goals are decomposed into quests with branching objectives and rewards.
- 2D top-down world: a cozy explorable world built on Phaser, running natively in the browser.
- Open source: self-hostable, extensible through a clean plugin API.

## How it works

1. Define real-world goals (habits, tasks, long-term objectives) — they become the world's quests.
2. Play to progress: complete quests during the day; the engine tracks stats, XP, and unlocks new content.
3. Grow over time: the character evolves with the player. There are no streaks to break, only a world to explore.

## Technology

- Built with Phaser 3 (HTML5 game framework).
- TypeScript + Vite toolchain.
- No backend required for the core experience; the landing page is a static Astro site.

## Target audience

People who want sustained motivation through gentle gamification rather than streak-guilt mechanics, and who enjoy life-simulation and productivity games.
